recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If broken inherited links are observed in a current IG, investigate the current IG Publisher repository/tooling with a focused reproducer rather than bulk-editing FHIR core narrative links.
issue_request: FHIR-15901 asked the IG Publisher to detect relative hyperlinks inherited in descriptions, comments, and similar narrative elements and rewrite them, for example by adding {{site.data.fhir.path}}, so derived IGs would not produce broken links.
initial_application: The Jira comments say "already fixed" and no current or historical source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-15901. Local history shows the requested mechanism in related tooling/source: commit 1c9659e5d6d32dee144d638e833580eac52524b9 changed generated conformance narrative from ../ to {{site.data.fhir.path}}, and the current CapabilityStatement narrative XSLT retains that setting.
additional_context: The current FHIR checkout has no tracked Java IG Publisher sources, so any remaining publisher behavior is outside current core source. Current XML narrative sources still intentionally contain many relative links: a scan found 327 files with 2147 relative .html hrefs. FHIR-I minutes for 2018-08-06 record FHIR-15901 as Persuasive in the block vote, and community searches found no substantive later discussion changing the conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current core source does not contain a spec text defect for this issue, and bulk-changing relative links in source narratives would be overbroad and inconsistent with current build practice.
